name: Does replacing siding around a door typically require permits in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: Does replacing siding around a door typically require permits in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Minor siding repairs around a door typically do not require a permit. However, if the project involves structural changes, modifying the wall assembly, or replacing a significant portion of the siding that affects structural integrity, a permit may be required by your local Bay Area building department. It's always best to check with your specific city or county building department (e.g., San Mateo County, Pacifica) to confirm requirements before starting work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor siding repairs usually don't require permits, but structural changes or extensive replacement might. Always check with your local Bay Area building department.
